subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] OpenClaw WebChat: Conversation Management & Multi-AI Collaboration

question: Should #27526 remain the canonical umbrella for both project/topic session organization and multi-AI collaboration, and which remaining pieces belong in OpenClaw core versus plugins or a separate API design?
rationale: Current main has implemented much of the session-sidebar slice, while the remaining committee, consensus, meeting, task, and durable project workflows cross persistent state, Gateway protocol, UI, and orchestration boundaries that require maintainer product direction.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
options.body: Keep #27526 open as the umbrella, then split concrete follow-ups for project/session metadata, directory navigation, and multi-agent collaboration semantics.

options.title: Narrow Core To Session UX
options.body: Treat the near-term core work as session grouping/search/switching polish only and leave committee-style collaboration outside this issue for now.

options.title: Route Collaboration Elsewhere
options.body: Use #13676, #7817, or a new plugin/API design issue for project and multi-agent workflows, then close this umbrella after that route is explicit.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
recommendation.body: Keep #27526 open as the umbrella, then split concrete follow-ups for project/session metadata, directory navigation, and multi-agent collaboration semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete made the canonical-tracker decision in the issue discussion and is the clearest owner for the product split decision.
